method: Native Windows UI through @oai/sky; fixture files read after Ctrl+S. No DOM injection or source-file writes were used to perform the formatting operation.
settings: Isolated test profile and fixture directory; Simplified Chinese UI; user-authorized 15-day free trial.
launch: Visible process launch is required. The earlier windowsHide option hid the editor behind the separate trial prompt. Later was clicked and the Acceptance.md editor was observed.
